rows.title: sourcing purchase orders handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] sourcing purchase orders records verified in status "received" must be moved to status "draft". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: sourcing purchase orders handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For sourcing purchase orders records verified in status "received": if the record's requested_by_employee_id is "12", move it to status "closed"; otherwise move it to status "draft". Apply exactly one transition.

rows.title: sourcing vendors handling procedure
rows.body: [CURRENT] Routine guidance for sourcing vendors records; no transitions are mandated by this document.
